ratings_why.fun: The Banner climbs steadily and Brother Onward cashes it in, a good late shape, but Tiers 1-3 run one text at a time, so early growth is thin and fiddly.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7: "only your Front speaks" turns reading order into a leader queue, so who dies first decides the fight. No current tribe or generic auto-battler plays like that.

verdict_why: One real rules gap remains (Herald copying a Loud card), and the early tiers could use one more working text.

points.text: Herald of the Herd copying a Loud card (Kit-Minder, Snow Hall Digger, Herding Council) copies the word Loud. Does Herald then work from any slot? Say yes or no on the card.
Turns 1-5 grow only the Front. One more Loud or 'from any slot' card at Tier 2 would give the early board a second thing growing without breaking the rule.
Herd Caller has to land as your Front, which means shuffling everyone back first. A 'When played: if this is your Front' version that also works played into F1 might read better.

Banner-Bearer, Banner-Stitcher and Herald give a permanent Banner that Brother Onward pays out to the whole board: a clear arc from Tier 2 to Tier 6. Worth showing the Banner number large in the shop.
Old Mother Lemen with Ole the Learned fills the back with copies of her body: a strong, readable high roll that sets up a second build well apart from the Cliff Cult.

standouts.why: Gerd the Shouter lets you set the order your leaders die in, and it helps one build while hurting another.
Brother Onward pays out the whole game's Banner at once, and you time it by placing Kits in front of him.
Trailbreaker is a cheap, readable way to push the lead forward and buff the next leader.

weakest.why: Herd Caller's 'must land as Front' makes a simple buffer fiddly to use.
Squeaker is fine on turn 1 and dead weight in the queue after that.
Thaw Nester fights Banner-Bearer for the one End of Turn spot and loses that fight early.

flags.note: The Front Lemming, Cantor of the Edge and a golden Brother Onward stack to about x4 in a fight. Not self-feeding, but check how high the Banner gets.
Golden Old Mother Lemen gives every Kit a doubled body plus the Banner, with Ole the Learned filling the board. A big high roll that crashes when she dies.
It's unclear whether copied Loud text makes Herald of the Herd Loud.
